items.title: Reverse
items.subtitle: Card trick
items.description: A field of floating playing cards, all face up except one. Flip it and it turns out to be an UNO Reverse, and the whole deck turns over.

items.title: A Sea of Small Lives
items.subtitle: Scroll story
items.description: A scroll-driven illustrated story drawn live in marker and watercolour, from a hill of fish to a dive beneath the surface.

items.title: Layered Water Garden
items.subtitle: Courtyard pools
items.description: A sunlit terracotta courtyard with real water physics. The water only ripples inside the painted pools, and the flowers float.

items.title: A little shelter
items.subtitle: Ink loop
items.description: A six-second ink loop: a little mouse shivers under a leaf while the wind carries the rain.

items.title: Keyspace
items.subtitle: Typing toy
items.description: A field of keycaps that light up as you type, gather into a globe you can spin, then unfold into a keyboard for a typing test.

items.title: Little Fizz
items.subtitle: Cola & ice
items.description: A frosted ice puppy that follows your pointer through a glass of sparkling cola.

items.title: No Plan Society
items.subtitle: Paper calendar
items.description: An interactive paper calendar built only from SVG, CSS and JavaScript. No WebGL, no dependencies.

items.title: Blossom Water
items.subtitle: Spring pool
items.description: A pale spring pool under a cherry tree. Tap the water to make ripples, drop a stone, or pause the breeze and watch the petals settle.

items.title: Stillwater
items.subtitle: Koi sketchbook
items.description: A quiet koi pond. The fish drift, react to your pointer and come over when you feed them. It's also packaged as a reusable React component.

items.title: Dragonflight
items.subtitle: Pixel skies
items.description: A pixel dragon with a real 3D skeleton, drawn by a tiny software renderer. Orbit the camera to fly over forests and rivers or dip below the clouds into a starry sky.
